summary: Frontend-only testing (iteration_4) for Architect 2.0 Phase-3 flows: Integrations hub, Usage & Billing, 3-step Import, GitHub PR dialog, Deploy drawer deployments (rollback/promote/logs), workspace Share dialog, and navigation. All 7 flows work end-to-end after fixing one critical runtime bug in ProjectWorkspace.jsx (missing `cn` import).

github_pr.simple_mode_git_tab_still_present: canvas-tab-git count=1 in simple too — renders friendly card variant

action_items: None — critical bug fixed in-place. Verify the one-liner import change (cn) is acceptable per style.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectWorkspace.jsx used `cn` at line 208 (public-link-toggle) without importing it — every workspace render threw `cn is not defined`, breaking the Share dialog toggle and the entire workspace. Fixed by adding `import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';` (already used the same helper across the app). This bug also broke the earlier /project navigation right after the import flow's `Open in Architect` step in my first pass, cascading into sidebar navigation failures.

Simple-mode Git tab visibility: `canvas-tab-git` renders in both simple and pro modes (count=1 in each). Requirement states simple mode should show the friendly 'saved to GitHub' card — verify CanvasTabs correctly switches the tab's inner content by mode; the tab button itself being present is acceptable.
Public preview URL uses the last 8 hex chars of the project id (e.g., /p/952745c3). Fine for a scripted mock; if this ever becomes real, collision risk is small but non-zero.

React key warning `Encountered two children with the same key` seen while a legacy project 'UI data tab test' is displayed. Pre-existing (also seen in iteration_3 context); not part of Phase-3 scope but worth flagging.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-3 flows are all green after adding the missing `cn` import to ProjectWorkspace.jsx. Reuse project proj_842fe362952745c3 (TEST_import_flow) or create a fresh one via /import. To reach the git PR dialog, first switch to Pro via Settings > segment-pro.
